variants.headline: Government cannot pay its debts
variants.body: The government of {colony} cannot pay its debts. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.

variants.headline: Public debt meets a payment failure
variants.body: The colony's government is unable to pay its debts. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.

variants.headline: The colony's government faces default
variants.body: Government debt in the colony cannot be paid by the administration. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.
